# Explicit quantum fold boundary

Implemented under #194 and the adopted edition-2026 QS/PR/RS/EXACT obligations. `qfor static` carries quantum-containing values; `for static` carries ordinary values. Both use the original common source judgment and existing deterministic fold elaboration/native gates. No new primitive, capacity, acceptance authority or proof discharge is introduced.

The informed [first context](context.md), [session](session.json) and original attempt-01 are preserved. Actual checks expose source-author mistakes and unsupported closed dyadic-control lowering; later attempts are explicit repairs, never replacements for first attempts. The final bounded QPE client uses existing CNOT phase kickback. Closed GHZ/arithmetic/mixed-carry/ordinary distributions and zero-width amplitude are checked independently.

[Validation](implementation-validation.json) distinguishes tests, numerical conformance, pending authoring work, current identity checks and older hosted CI. [Surface review](implementation-surface-review.json) records the token/AST change and unchanged capacities/native boundary. [Active test migration](active-test-migration.json) binds the predecessor files; the small `tests/fixtures/frontend_v030/qfor/source-map.json` selects current derivatives without editing corpus originals or historical authoring sources. Fixed historical Fourier regression sources only migrate their fold spelling; generic QFT remains outside the goal.

No blind-model performance, full source-preservation theorem, broad constitutional certification or Issue completion is claimed.
